Leah (CSM): Anya flagged a big drop in VertexWorks calls after our handoff. usage down ~82% since demo. anyone on this account?
Omar (AE): Seen it. New ML lead Marcus joined and procurement mentioned they9re testing a competitor (FluxCore) for cost on long-doc folding.
Dev (Solutions Eng): any recent infra changes? model swaps, quantization, config?
Leah (CSM): only routine patch on 12/02. I queried: ```SELECT day, sum(tokens) FROM api_calls WHERE account='vertexworks' AND day>= '2025-12-01' GROUP BY day;``` shows near-zero after 12/04.
billing-bot: invoice VERT-2025-12 created 2025-12-05	status: unpaid.
Marcus (VertexWorks): hey team	we9re running a side-by-side with FluxCore; they demoed a prefetch + pruning flow that looked cheaper. also our security team wants a VPC diagram.
Omar (AE): action: prepare VPC/KMS doc, cost comparison vs FluxCore, and offer a short no-charge trial week with caching enabled.
Dev (Solutions Eng): mitigation plan: enable prefix KV caching for top templates, add chunked streaming, and run a token-cost sim. expect 20-35% token reduction for their workload.
Leah (CSM): suggested outreach: "Can we book 30m to review security diagram and run a 1-week no-cost dedicated trial with caching so you can compare results?"
Marcus (VertexWorks): sounds fair. Thu morning works. please send VPC/KMS doc ahead of time so security can review.
Leah (CSM): will send docs and block Thu 9am. Omar will draft the competitive slide. Dev will run perf sim and cost projection.
Leah (CSM): action items recap: Leah -> send security pack + schedule; Dev -> perf sim + KV config; Omar -> competitive pricing slide. billing-bot: note flagged unpaid invoice to AE.
Leah (CSM): keeping this high priority. will update after Thu call. :eyes:
